"## Objective
Begin the next AGENT HQ milestone on a preserved working branch. Do not merge into main or deploy publicly.

## First: recovery and verification
- Preserve `main` and `opencode-resume/c17d689967ad0b4e055c`.
- Confirm the exact current HEAD and working tree state in the OMGithub workspace.
- Inspect the existing Phase 2 implementation and its test/build scripts.
- Run the existing tests, type checks and production build; report exact commands and results.
- Do not rewrite existing research/task functionality merely to make tests pass.
- If the OpenCode provider is unavailable due capacity/quota, stop cleanly and report it; do not loop or consume repeated retries.

## Phase 3A scope: secure single-operator foundation
1. Add an operator authentication boundary suitable for the current single-operator deployment model.
2. Protect task creation, approval actions, and any future financial or customer-data endpoints.
3. Keep public prospect research safe: validate URLs, block private/local destinations, revalidate redirects, and document remaining DNS-rebinding limitations.
4. Add explicit permission/approval states for consequential actions.
5. Add an audit trail for operator identity, action, timestamp, target and outcome, without logging secrets.
6. Add configuration validation and safe startup behavior when required auth configuration is missing.
7. Document local/mobile setup and safe deployment boundaries.

## Financial governance requirements (design and data model only in this milestone)
- LEDGER may calculate, forecast, reconcile and recommend.
- Only the owner/operator may approve DD internal spending, subscriptions, model/API credits, hosting upgrades or transfers.
- No autonomous spend, payment, refund, subscription or transfer.
- Internal upgrade budgets must be constrained to an owner-approved percentage of realised profit, never gross revenue or unpaid invoices.
- Weekly founder compensation must be calculated from approved policy and available cash; do not hard-code a salary or initiate transfers.
- Keep client project funds, tax provisions, operating reserve and DD internal upgrade funds distinct.
- Do not connect a payment provider or real bank/crypto account in this milestone.

## Acceptance criteria
- Existing Phase 2 behavior remains intact.
- Authentication and authorization tests cover unauthenticated and unauthorized actions.
- Audit tests verify sensitive values are not recorded.
- Financial governance has tests proving no spending action can execute without explicit owner approval.
- Tests, typecheck and build pass.
- Provide a concise verification report and list any remaining security limitations.

## Constraints
- Prefer existing dependencies and free/local tooling.
- Do not add paid model/API dependencies.
- Do not expose credentials or ask the operator to paste secrets into chat.
- No production deployment, merge, payment execution, email sending, customer outreach or social publishing.
- Keep changes on a new isolated branch and open a draft PR for review only after all checks pass.

---
This is a build request. Build a complete, playable game now (or apply the requested change to the existing game). Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly when you finish.
"
